caption:
59.2 km from Nosara brings the expedition to the bay at Tamarindo.

We ride north along the Guanacaste surf coast, passing San Juanillo, Marbella, Playa Negra, and Avellanas. With 782 m of ascent, the stage sits flat and fast after the climbs above Nosara.

You finish at Hotel Capitán Suizo on the south end of the bay. The hardest climbing of the week is behind you, leaving 1 final ride of 23.8 km to Brasilito.

We built this route to move from the interior of Nicoya out to its open beaches, giving your legs a fast day on the dirt before returning to San José.

Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
